apps/web/components/organisms/BillingDas.permission-denied: Billing is per-account and the route is already behind sign-in; the component has no permission gate, so a denied state is unreachable.

apps/web/components/providers/ErrorBound.permission-denied: The boundary only catches render errors and has no permission check; a denial is the child's concern and arrives as an ordinary error.

apps/web/components/shell/ContextMenuOve.error: The menu only lists caller-supplied actions and has no data, request or failure path.
apps/web/components/shell/ContextMenuOve.permission-denied: A caller omits or disables actions the person may not use; the overlay itself has no permission check (see the disabled item in the Partial story).

apps/web/components/shell/PriorityGlyph..error: A pure presentational glyph with no data, request or failure path; the urgent level already shows the alarm styling.
